messages:
Maya: Quick sync — field feedback sampling for design partners next week. Need agreement on sample prompts, telemetry hooks, and interview cadence. Who's in?
Owen: I'm in. thinking 3 partners, 5 engineers each, 2-week window. keep it lightweight.
Sophia: +1. we should predefine 10 typed prompts and 5 open prompts. also capture token budgets.
Maya: sounds good. @Zack can you confirm telemetry event names? we want per-prompt success + qualitative tag.
Zack: Yup. event names: dp_feedback_prompt, dp_feedback_rating, dp_followup_flag. I can add a small shim to the console to capture start/finish durations.
Jess: For recruitment — suggest 3 partners: AcmeHealth, LumaAds, BoxCo. Acme wants VPC/private preview, others ok hosted.
Maya: Good call. Acme's compliance ask will push to Private track. For hosted partners, we can run chrome extension. timeline?
Owen: Timeline: recruit by Fri, run 2/15–2/28, interviews during 3/1–3/5, internal eval by 3/10.
Sophia: Launch criteria: 80% coverage of defined prompts, ability to reproduce regressions locally, <2% severe failure rate (crash/index error), clear action items per partner.
Zack: Telemetry shim ready by Mon. will add a sampling flag: dp_sample=beta2026
Maya: Who owns follow-ups/interviews? @Jess?
Jess: I'll coordinate interviews + create guide. sample interview questions included.
Maya: Great. Also let's budget incentives: $1k per partner + swag. Thoughts?
Owen: Fine. keep invoices simple.
Sophia: We need consent and data retention doc. @Legal?
feedback-bot: Note: NDA template v3.2 uploaded to /legal/templates/NDA_dp_v3.2.pdf
Maya: perfect. add retention window 90 days by default, extend on request.
Zack: Also: telemetry will flag PII — we'll send hashed/stripped data. add consent checkbox.
Jess: Ops: create calendar invites + Loom intro. will post templates to #dp-onboarding.
Maya: Ok owners: recruitment=Jess, telemetry=Zack, prompts=Sophia, timeline=Owen. I'll own coord + exec update.
Owen: one risk: model version drift mid-run. plan fallback? suggest pinned model + automatic fallback to earlier ver with notes.
Sophia: add eval criterion: no downstream score drop >5% vs baseline for critical prompts.
Maya: next meeting Mon 10am PT. Action items: Jess recruit 3 partners, Zack telemetry shim + doc, Sophia produce prompt set (10 typed, 5 open), Owen publish timeline to calendar, Maya exec note.
Jess: On it, will post progress PR to docs repo.
Maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
